notes.title: Super Kakuro Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hi Kakuro players,

I am still working on Super Kakuro. Whilst I hoped to have the game fully-finished by my planned release date, I am still working on a few features. The leaderboards, achievements and some features related to in-game assistance are still to be finished. 

With this considered, and to publish the game with an acceptable standard of quality, I have pushed the release date back to November 2nd. By this date, I expect to have all features implemented and have the game at its best. 

Thanks for your patience, Super Kakuro will be with you very soon!

Cyril.
